title: Payment failed
description: A wallet top-up or an invoice payment ended without money: Stripe could not collect it, or the customer's attempts were all declined. The wallet and the invoice were not changed. This schema describes the `data` member of the delivered document; the envelope (id, type, tenantId, occurredAt, data) is described in README.md.

invoiceId.description: The invoice this payment was for. Absent for a wallet top-up.

money.description: An amount in minor units (cents, dong) of one ISO 4217 currency.
